articles.title: Norwest invests over Rs 300 cr growth equity in SILA’s realty development business
articles.summary: Global investment firm Norwest has invested over Rs 300 crore in SILA Properties, the real estate development arm of Indian company SILA, valuing it at Rs 1,000 crore. This significant capital infusion signals robust investor confidence in India's growing real estate sector, underscoring its potential for national economic growth and development through foreign capital.

articles.title: Netflix Sets November 2026 Release Date for True Crime Drama ‘Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping’
articles.summary: A new Netflix series, 'Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping,' revisits the shocking real-life abduction of hotel matriarch Toos van der Valk, an event that gripped the Netherlands 44 years ago. Featuring actors Lies Visschedijk and Frank Lammers, the production brings this historical crime saga to modern audiences, highlighting its enduring impact on Dutch society.

articles.title: NEET paper leak case: CBI files supplementary chargesheet against 14th accused
articles.summary: The CBI has filed a supplementary chargesheet in a Delhi court against an accused in the ongoing NEET paper leak case. This development signifies continued efforts by national agencies to investigate and address malpractice in crucial national examinations. For SSB aspirants, it underscores the importance of fair selection processes and the government's commitment to maintaining integrity in competitive exams.

articles.title: Clayface star Tom Rhys Harries lets slip that Matt Hagen knows Batman is in Gotham during the movie: "We have footage"
articles.summary: During the Clayface press tour, actor Tom Rhys Harries reportedly hinted that Batman will be present in Gotham City concurrently with the events of the new DCU Clayface movie. This potential spoiler emerged from an interview with ComicBook, suggesting a shared universe approach and offering fans an early glimpse into the dynamic of the upcoming cinematic installment, piquing interest among comic book enthusiasts.

articles.title: What we know about Russia's overnight strikes on Ukraine
articles.summary: Russian forces executed overnight missile and drone strikes targeting Kyiv, impacting a crucial energy facility and a residential building on the city's outskirts. The attacks tragically resulted in at least three people killed and 21 injured, highlighting the severe humanitarian and infrastructure consequences of the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.

articles.title: LAC must be stable for normalisation of ties with China: EAM S Jaishankar
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar affirmed that stable conditions along the Line of Actual Control (LAC) are fundamental for normalizing India-China relations. He asserted that any border disturbance directly impacts the overall bilateral relationship, reiterating India's consistent position. This highlights the nation's firm stance that peace and tranquility on the border are essential prerequisites for improving broader diplomatic and economic ties.

articles.title: Commodity Traders Rake In Cash During Trump Administration
articles.summary: Global commodity traders were caught bribing officials across Latin America and Africa to secure lucrative state oil contracts, violating anti-corruption laws. This scandal revealed extensive illicit practices aimed at gaining unfair advantages in international energy markets. Such incidents highlight the pervasive challenge of global corruption, impacting fair trade and governance, and emphasizing the need for robust enforcement and ethical corporate conduct worldwide.

articles.title: LAC must be stable for normalisation of ties with China: EAM Jaishankar
articles.summary: External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar stated that a stable Line of Actual Control (LAC) is paramount for normalizing India-China relations, stressing that border disturbances directly impact bilateral ties. For SSB aspirants, this underscores India's firm diplomatic stance on national security, emphasizing that peace along the LAC is crucial for regional stability and broader geopolitical engagement.

articles.title: Why border security force SSB is asking soldiers to stay away from unknown calls, OTP requests
articles.summary: The Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) has issued a vital warning to its personnel against growing online threats like honey traps, cyber fraud, and financial scams. Personnel are strictly advised to avoid sharing private photographs or sensitive information online and to meticulously verify all suspicious communications. This advisory aims to protect servicemen from exploitation, safeguard personal data, and ultimately uphold national security interests.
